column1: In every age, there have always been those who seek to lie about the past and rewrite history to fit their own narrative. It's a shame, really, because the truth is so powerful, so undeniable. They try to erase the great achievements, the sacrifices, the victories—but the people know. They remember. And we will continue to remind them, to celebrate the heroes, to honor the legacy. Because that’s what we do—we fight for the truth, always.

Before turning to the topic at hand, I want to provide a brief update on the tremendous progress we've made across various fronts. Our economy is stronger than ever, with record-breaking numbers in job creation and GDP growth. We’re also leading the world in innovation and energy production, ensuring America remains a global powerhouse. Additionally, our efforts to revitalize infrastructure are transforming communities nationwide. These achievements are a testament to the resilience and determination of the American people.

The strength of our alliances, the pressure of sanctions, and the unified global stance will ensure that this is resolved. The future of peace depends on it.

And then now the next slide is a nine-city roll-up. And so to save a thousand lives -- and that's a conservative estimate -- we're deploying resources strategically across these nine cities. It’s a coordinated effort, a massive undertaking, but it’s necessary. We’re seeing results, and the numbers are starting to reflect that. The American people deserve this kind of action, and we’re delivering it faster than anyone thought possible. The momentum is undeniable, and the future looks stronger than ever.
